name.zh: Agent 行为约束与输出风格
上下文、记忆与 Token 优化

description.zh: 代码库索引与语义搜索的 MCP 服务器（需要 uv，以及自备的索引服务地址和令牌；没有带真实的地址和令牌验证过）
description.en: MCP server for codebase indexing and semantic search (needs uv, plus your own indexing service URL and token; not verified with a real URL and token)

description.zh: 索引服务的 API 地址；留空的话装好后在 ~/.acemcp/settings.toml 里填 BASE_URL
description.en: API URL of the indexing service; leave blank to set BASE_URL in ~/.acemcp/settings.toml later

description.zh: 索引服务的认证令牌；留空的话装好后在 ~/.acemcp/settings.toml 里填 TOKEN
description.en: Auth token of the indexing service; leave blank to set TOKEN in ~/.acemcp/settings.toml later

description.zh: 给代码库建一张本地的结构图谱，让 AI 审查和改代码时只读相关的部分（需要 uv）
description.en: Builds a local structural graph of your codebase so AI reads only the relevant parts when reviewing or changing code (needs uv)

description.zh: 跨 AI Agent 共用的本地记忆层，在不同 Agent 和会话之间保留项目知识
description.en: Local memory layer shared across AI agents, keeping project knowledge between agents and sessions

description.zh: 把各种库最新的、对应版本的官方文档和代码示例取进对话
description.en: Pulls up-to-date, version-specific library docs and code examples into the conversation

description.zh: Context7 的 API key，填了限额更高；不填也能用
description.en: Context7 API key for higher rate limits; works without one

description.zh: 用 Firecrawl 搜索、抓取和提取网页内容（没有带 key 验证过）
description.en: Searches, scrapes and extracts web content through Firecrawl (not verified with a real key)

description.zh: Firecrawl 的 API key
description.en: Firecrawl API key

description.zh: 用 Grok 做联网搜索，用 Tavily 抓取网页和梳理站点结构（需要 uv；没有带 key 验证过）
description.en: Web search through Grok, with page fetching and site mapping through Tavily (needs uv; not verified with real keys)

description.zh: Grok 接口的地址，要是 OpenAI 兼容格式，如 https://你的服务地址/v1
description.en: Grok API URL in OpenAI-compatible format, e.g. https://your-endpoint/v1

description.zh: Grok 接口的密钥
description.en: Grok API key

description.zh: Tavily 的 API key；不填的话抓取网页和梳理站点这两个工具用不了
description.en: Tavily API key; without it the page fetching and site mapping tools are unavailable

description.zh: 让 AI 操控并检查一个真实的 Chrome 浏览器，做自动化操作、调试和性能分析
description.en: Lets AI control and inspect a live Chrome browser for automation, debugging and performance analysis

description.zh: 基于 Playwright 的浏览器自动化，靠页面的结构化快照操作网页，不需要截图
description.en: Browser automation built on Playwright, driving pages through structured snapshots instead of screenshots

description.zh: 让 AI 查阅 shadcn/ui 的组件、区块、示例和元数据，支持 React、Svelte、Vue 和 React Native
description.en: Gives AI access to shadcn/ui components, blocks, examples and metadata for React, Svelte, Vue and React Native

description.zh: GitHub 的访问令牌（不需要勾任何权限），填了每小时可请求 5000 次；不填也能用
description.en: GitHub access token (no scopes needed) for 5000 requests per hour; works without one

description.zh: 创建、读取和修改 Excel 工作簿（需要 uv；这样装不限定它能打开哪个文件夹里的文件）
description.en: Creates, reads and edits Excel workbooks (needs uv; installed this way it is not restricted to a folder)

description.zh: 创建、读取和修改 Word 文档（需要 uv；上游仓库已归档，不再更新）
description.en: Creates, reads and edits Word documents (needs uv; the upstream repository is archived and no longer updated)

description.zh: 规范驱动开发的工具包：先把需求写成规格，再让 AI 编码 Agent 照着出方案、拆任务、实现
description.en: Toolkit for spec-driven development: write requirements as a spec, then have your AI coding agent plan, break down and implement against it

description.zh: 给 AI 编码助手用的规范驱动开发框架，先把要改什么写成规格，再动手写代码
description.en: Spec-driven development framework for AI coding assistants: write down what will change as a spec before any code is written

description.zh: 让 AI 编码 Agent 围绕一个可测量的指标反复改进代码的迭代优化循环工具
description.en: Iterative optimization loop that has AI coding agents repeatedly improve code against one measurable metric

description.zh: 自主运行的 AI Agent 循环，反复调用编码 Agent，直到需求文档（PRD）里的每一项都完成
description.en: Autonomous AI agent loop that runs a coding agent over and over until every item in the PRD is complete

description.zh: 循环运行 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等编码 Agent 的命令行工具，直到任务或需求文档（PRD）完成
description.en: CLI that runs coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode in a loop until the task or PRD is done

description.zh: 用一条 ralph 命令让 OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex 或 Copilot 在循环里反复执行同一个提示词，直到任务完成
description.en: One ralph command that keeps OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex or Copilot running the same prompt in a loop until the task is done

description.zh: AI 想提前结束对话时弹出对话框，让你接着追问，直到问题真正解决
description.en: Pops up a dialog when the AI tries to wrap up early, so you can keep going until the problem is actually solved

description.zh: 把代码库索引成知识图谱的 MCP 服务器，供 AI 查代码结构、调用链和改动的影响面
description.en: MCP server that indexes a codebase into a knowledge graph for structure, call-chain and change-impact queries

description.zh: 给代码库建图谱并接进 Claude Code、Codex 等编码 Agent，让它们带着代码库的上下文工作
description.en: Builds a graph of your codebase and wires it into coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex for codebase-aware context

description.zh: 代码库索引、语义搜索和提示词增强的 MCP 服务器
description.en: MCP server for codebase indexing, semantic search and prompt enhancement

description.zh: 用 Rust 写的 MCP 服务器，做代码库索引、语义搜索和提示词增强
description.en: MCP server written in Rust for codebase indexing, semantic search and prompt enhancement

description.zh: 在本地给代码库建语义图谱，让编码 Agent 用更少的工具调用拿到准确的上下文
description.en: Builds a local semantic graph of your codebase so coding agents get accurate context with fewer tool calls

description.zh: 带网页界面和命令行的代码理解 Agent，自己调用大模型回答关于代码库的问题，也提供 MCP 模式
description.en: Code-understanding agent with a web UI and CLI that answers questions about a codebase using an LLM, also available as an MCP server

description.zh: Augment Code 的终端编码 Agent，能理解代码库并按自然语言的要求分析和修改代码（需要 Augment 账号）
description.en: Augment Code's terminal coding agent that understands your codebase and analyzes and edits code from natural-language requests (needs an Augment account)

description.zh: 在命令行里用自然语言对代码、图片、PDF 等内容做语义搜索（需要 Mixedbread 账号）
description.en: Semantic search from the command line over code, images, PDFs and more using natural language (needs a Mixedbread account)

description.zh: 自动记录 AI Agent 在会话里做过的事并压缩成摘要，在以后的会话里把相关内容带回来
description.en: Automatically captures what your AI agent does in a session, compresses it into summaries and brings the relevant context back in later sessions

description.zh: 把终端输出和 AI 编码会话记进本地的工作记忆，之后可以搜索和复用
description.en: Local working memory for terminal output and AI coding sessions that you and your agent can search and reuse later

description.zh: 基于 Langflow、Docling 和 OpenSearch 的检索增强生成（RAG）平台，上传文档后在聊天界面里搜索和提问
description.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) platform built on Langflow, Docling and OpenSearch: upload documents, then search and ask questions in a chat interface

description.zh: 把工具的大段输出放进沙箱处理，只把结果交给 AI，节省上下文窗口并保留会话记忆
description.en: Processes large tool outputs in a sandbox and hands only the result to the AI, saving context window and keeping session memory

description.zh: 在工具输出、日志、文件等内容送进大模型之前先压缩，减少 token 用量
description.en: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files and other content before they reach the LLM to cut token usage

description.zh: 在常用开发命令的输出送进大模型之前先过滤压缩的命令行代理，减少 token 用量
description.en: CLI proxy that filters and compresses the output of common dev commands before it reaches the LLM to cut token usage

description.zh: OpenCode 的插件，自动清理和压缩对话上下文来减少 token 用量
description.en: OpenCode plugin that automatically prunes and compresses conversation context to cut token usage

description.zh: 用 Rust 写的轻量 MCP 服务器，经 Grok 或 OpenAI 兼容的接口联网搜索，并用 Tavily、Firecrawl 抓取网页
description.en: Lightweight MCP server written in Rust for web search through Grok or OpenAI-compatible APIs, with page fetching through Tavily and Firecrawl

description.zh: 给编码 Agent 用的 Playwright 命令行，用命令操作浏览器、检查选择器、截图和生成 Playwright 代码
description.en: Playwright command line for coding agents to drive the browser, inspect selectors, take screenshots and generate Playwright code

description.zh: 给 AI Agent 做浏览器自动化用的浏览器，Agent 在各自隔离的空间里操作并共用你的登录状态，不打断你自己的浏览（目前只有 macOS 版）
description.en: Browser for AI agent automation: agents work in isolated spaces and share your logged-in state without interrupting your own browsing (macOS only for now)

description.zh: Web 自动化与测试框架，用同一套 API 驱动 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit
description.en: Framework for web automation and testing that drives Chromium, Firefox and WebKit through a single API

description.zh: 嵌在网页里的纯 JavaScript 界面 Agent，让用户用自然语言操作你的 Web 应用，不需要浏览器扩展或无头浏览器（要自备大模型）
description.en: In-page GUI agent in plain JavaScript that lets users control your web app with natural language, with no browser extension or headless browser (bring your own LLM)

description.zh: 向编码 Agent 描述一套视觉设计体系的 DESIGN.md 格式规范，附带检查和导出用的命令行
description.en: Format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents in a DESIGN.md file, with a CLI to lint and export it

description.zh: 从知名品牌的设计体系整理出的 DESIGN.md 文件合集，供编码 Agent 照着做出同样风格的界面
description.en: Collection of DESIGN.md files derived from popular brands' design systems, for coding agents to follow when generating UI in the same style

description.zh: 本地优先的桌面设计工作台，让你的编码 Agent 生成原型、落地页、幻灯片、图片和视频并导出成文件
description.en: Local-first desktop design workbench where your coding agent produces prototypes, landing pages, slides, images and video as exportable files

description.zh: 开源的设计与原型平台，可以在浏览器里用或自行部署，基于 SVG、CSS、HTML 等开放标准
description.en: Open-source design and prototyping platform, usable in the browser or self-hosted, built on open standards such as SVG, CSS and HTML

description.zh: 社区贡献的开源 UI 元素合集，每个元素用 CSS 或 Tailwind 写成，可以直接拿来用
description.en: Community-made open-source collection of UI elements written in CSS or Tailwind, free to copy and use

description.zh: 创意画布组件库，在真实的 HTML 上叠加 WebGL 特效，支持 React、Vue、Svelte 和原生 JavaScript
description.en: Library of creative canvas components that run WebGL effects over real HTML, for React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla JavaScript

description.zh: 把一张截图转成 HTML、Tailwind、React 或 Vue 代码的应用
description.en: App that converts a screenshot into HTML, Tailwind, React or Vue code

description.zh: 分析界面截图，拆出组件和设计规律，生成给 AI 编码工具用的详细提示词
description.en: Analyzes a UI screenshot, breaks down its components and design patterns, and generates a detailed prompt for AI coding tools

description.zh: 本地优先的 Chrome 扩展，把网页上的图片、截图或页面区域转成可以直接拿去生成图像的提示词（要自备能识图的大模型接口）
description.en: Local-first Chrome extension that writes image-generator prompts from images, screenshots or regions of a page (bring your own vision-capable LLM endpoint)

description.zh: GPT Image 2 的提示词与案例库，附完整提示词、可套用的模板和配套的 Skill
description.en: Prompt and case library for GPT Image 2, with full prompts, reusable templates and companion skills

description.zh: 把 AI 编码助手变成视频制作流水线的开源系统，由 Agent 完成调研、写脚本、生成素材、剪辑和合成
description.en: Open-source system that turns your AI coding assistant into a video production pipeline: research, scripting, asset generation, editing and compositing

description.zh: 计算机视觉的 Python 工具库，提供数据集加载、标注绘制、区域计数等可复用的组件
description.en: Python toolkit for computer vision with reusable building blocks for loading datasets, drawing annotations and counting objects in zones

description.zh: 把 PDF、Office 文档等复杂文件转成适合大模型读的 Markdown 或 JSON
description.en: Converts complex documents such as PDFs and Office files into LLM-ready Markdown or JSON

description.zh: 开源的 PDF 编辑平台，可以当桌面应用用、在浏览器里用或部署到自己的服务器，对 PDF 做编辑、签名、遮盖和转换
description.en: Open-source PDF editing platform that runs as a desktop app, in the browser or on your own server, for editing, signing, redacting and converting PDFs

description.zh: 检查、分类 PDF 并提取文本的 Rust 库，能分辨扫描版和文本版，也有 Python 包和命令行
description.en: Rust library for inspecting, classifying and extracting text from PDFs that tells scanned from text-based files, also available as a Python package and CLI

description.zh: 给 AI Agent 用的命令行工具，读取、编辑和自动化处理 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文件，不需要安装 Office
description.en: Command-line tool for AI agents to read, edit and automate Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, with no Office installation required

description.zh: 给大模型配上 MCP 工具，让它读取、编辑和自动化处理 Excel 表格的 AI Agent
description.en: AI agent for Excel that gives LLMs MCP tools to read, edit and automate spreadsheets

description.zh: 在 Markdown、HTML、Word、LaTeX 等多种文档格式之间互相转换的命令行工具
description.en: Command-line tool that converts documents between formats such as Markdown, HTML, Word and LaTeX

description.zh: 把 Markdown 和网页上的 AI 对话内容按原格式粘贴进 Word、WPS 和 Excel 的桌面工具
description.en: Desktop utility that pastes Markdown and AI chat responses from the web into Word, WPS and Excel with formatting intact

description.zh: 把 PDF、Office 文档等各种文件转成 Markdown 的 Python 工具，方便交给大模型处理
description.en: Python tool that converts PDFs, Office documents and other files to Markdown for use with LLMs

description.zh: 完全在浏览器里处理文件的 PDF 工具集，编辑、转换、合并、拆分和加密都不用上传到服务器
description.en: PDF toolkit that runs entirely in your browser to edit, convert, merge, split and secure files without uploading them to a server

description.zh: 把格式混乱的 Word 文档自动排成符合规范的版式的桌面应用
description.en: Desktop app that automatically reformats messy Word documents into a standards-compliant layout

description.zh: 优化 AI 提示词的工具，有网页版、桌面版、Chrome 扩展和 Docker 部署四种用法
description.en: Tool for optimizing AI prompts, available as a web app, desktop app, Chrome extension or Docker deployment

description.zh: DSPy 的提示词优化器 GEPA：读执行轨迹，反思失败的原因，自动改写流程里每一步的提示词
description.en: GEPA, a prompt optimizer in DSPy that reads execution traces, reflects on failures and automatically rewrites the prompt of each step in a pipeline

description.zh: 给论文润色、以降低 AI 生成内容检测率为目标的学术写作工具
description.en: Academic writing tool that polishes papers with the aim of lowering their AI-generated-content detection score

description.zh: 基于 AI 的小说创作助手，帮你构思并写出故事
description.en: AI-powered novel writing assistant that helps you plan and write stories

description.zh: 阿里巴巴开源的代码审查工具，把确定性的流水线和大模型 Agent 结合起来，给出行级的审查意见
description.en: Alibaba's open-source code review tool that combines deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent to produce line-level review comments

description.zh: 在浏览器里批注和审查 AI 编码 Agent 的计划与代码改动，再把意见发回给 Agent
description.en: Browser-based review UI for annotating your coding agent's plans and code diffs and sending the feedback back to the agent

description.zh: 针对 Web 应用和 API 的 AI 渗透测试工具，分析源代码、找出攻击路径并实际执行利用来证明漏洞存在
description.en: AI penetration-testing tool for web apps and APIs that reads your source code, finds attack paths and runs real exploits to prove each vulnerability

description.zh: 用 Agent 来评估其它 Agent 完成任务的过程和结果的评测框架
description.en: Evaluation framework that uses agents to judge how other agents carry out and complete their tasks
